account: According to arrest papers cited by WCTV, Florida State University police responded to the St. Augustine parking garage at about 2:30 a.m. on Saturday 2 May 2026. ZeroEyes gun detection technology had detected an individual in black pointing a gun on the bottom level. Camera footage showed Tyler Farmer, 19, brandishing a loaded firearm at four other people. Officers found a Glock 19 handgun, stolen from Miller County, Georgia, in his waistband. He was charged with possessing a firearm on school property, unlawful carry, improper display of a firearm and grand theft of a firearm. He bonded out on Sunday. The Tallahassee Democrat, citing court records, says police responded to a “ZeroEyes camera notification” and that Farmer is not an FSU student. ZeroEyes layers over existing cameras and routes human-verified detections to police.

ai_role.statement: Court documents (as reported) attribute the police response to a ZeroEyes camera notification. Human analysts verify detections before alerts, so the AI's contribution is the initial detection. Both sources are local news citing arrest papers. Neither quantifies response time or states whether anyone else had called police.

fields.account: According to arrest papers cited by WCTV, Florida State University police responded to the St. Augustine parking garage at about 2:30 a.m. on Saturday 2 May 2026. ZeroEyes gun detection technology had detected an individual in black pointing a gun on the bottom level. Camera footage showed Tyler Farmer, 19, brandishing a loaded firearm at four other people. Officers found a Glock 19 handgun, stolen from Miller County, Georgia, in his waistband. He was charged with possessing a firearm on school property, unlawful carry, improper display of a firearm and grand theft of a firearm. He bonded out on Sunday. The Tallahassee Democrat, citing court records, says police responded to a “ZeroEyes camera notification” and that Farmer is not an FSU student. ZeroEyes layers over existing cameras and routes human-verified detections to police.
